name: pixel-studio
description: MVP pixel art editor desktop app with Electron, React, and SQLite

scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 nodemon --watch dist-electron --ext js --exec "electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.rebuild: cross-env HOME=.cache/home USERPROFILE=.cache/home npm_config_devdir=.cache/electron-gyp ELECTRON_CACHE=.cache/electron electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3
